name: Button
summary: A single-action control. Choose emphasis by appearance (primary > secondary > outline > subtle > transparent), size by the density of the surrounding layout, and shape to match its neighbours; one button per primary action on a surface.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: The label. A button with an icon and no label is icon-only and lays out square.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: One 20px icon (24px at large), before or after the label.

inputs.name: iconPosition
inputs.description: Which side of the label the icon sits on.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: Colour treatment. secondary is the neutral filled default; primary the brand fill; outline a border with no fill; subtle and transparent have no border and no fill at rest and differ only in their hover tint.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: rounded takes the size's radius; circular is a pill; square has none.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Selects height (24, 32, 40), padding, minimum width, text style and icon size together.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Draws the disabled colours and takes no input; also removed from the tab order.

inputs.name: disabledFocusable
inputs.description: Looks disabled and ignores activation but stays focusable, so assistive technology can still reach and describe it.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Runs on a click or on Enter or Space while focused.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The inline-flex box: background, border, radius and padding; centres icon and label on both axes.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: A square slot for the icon, 20px at small and medium, 24px at large, with a gap to the label on its inner side.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The text, in the size's text style; one line, no wrapping.

variants.description: Neutral fill Background 1 with a Stroke 1 border and Foreground 1 text, all three stepping to their Hover and Pressed tokens.
Brand fill with no visible border and on-brand text; hover and press step the brand background.
Secondary's border and text over a transparent background; hover and press tint the background with the Transparent family.
No border; Subtle background, transparent at rest and a neutral tint on hover and press; Foreground 2 text whose icon turns brand on hover.
No border; Transparent background family; Foreground 2 text that itself turns brand on hover and press.
24px tall: 3px vertical and spacingHorizontalS padding, 64px minimum width, caption1-sized regular text, borderRadiusMedium (the focus ring uses borderRadiusSmall).
32px tall: 5px vertical and spacingHorizontalM padding, 96px minimum width, body1 size at semibold, borderRadiusMedium.
40px tall: 8px vertical and spacingHorizontalL padding, 96px minimum width, body2 size at semibold, borderRadiusMedium (the focus ring uses borderRadiusLarge).

layout.text: The root is an inline-flex box centring its children on both axes, with a border of strokeWidthThin on every appearance (transparent where the appearance shows none) so the size never changes between appearances.
Medium pads 5px vertically and spacingHorizontalM horizontally, so with the 20px line height and 1px borders it stands 32px tall; minimum width 96px.
Small pads 3px vertically (1px when it has an icon, since the 20px icon exceeds the 16px line height) and spacingHorizontalS horizontally: 24px tall, minimum width 64px.
Large pads 8px vertically (7px with an icon, whose 24px matches the 22px line height plus 2) and spacingHorizontalL horizontally: 40px tall, minimum width 96px.

The icon slot is 20px square at small and medium and 24px at large; when a label follows or precedes it, the gap between them is spacingHorizontalXS at small and spacingHorizontalSNudge at medium and large.
An icon-only button is square: its padding equals the size's with-icon vertical padding on every side and its width is pinned to the height, 24, 32 or 40px, overriding the minimum width.
The label is fontFamilyBase at the size's font size, line height and weight: regular at small, semibold at medium and large; no wrapping, no text decoration.

states.text: Rest: the appearance's background, border and text tokens with no suffix; secondary, outline and (through the base) every appearance also declares no shadow at rest except that the focus style on primary composes shadow2.

Background, border and text swap to their Hover tokens together and the pointer becomes a hand; subtle and transparent additionally turn their icon (subtle) or text (transparent) to the Brand hover foreground, and swap a regular icon for its filled twin.
While the pointer is down over it, or Space is held while focus-visible, background, border and text take their Pressed tokens; pressed wins over hover.

Keyboard focus draws the indicator inside the box: the border turns colorStrokeFocus2, a 1px colorStrokeFocus2 ring is inset from the edge, and a 2px transparent outline reserves the outer space; the ring follows the size's radius (small borderRadiusSmall, large borderRadiusLarge) or the shape's when circular or square. Primary adds a 2px on-brand ring inside the 1px one and composes shadow2, and drops the inner ring while hovered.

Background, border, text and icon take the Disabled tokens and the pointer shows not-allowed; outline, subtle and transparent keep a transparent background and primary keeps a transparent border, so only the text and border colours announce it there. Hover and press change nothing.

behaviour.text: A left click, or Enter or Space while focused, runs onClick; the pressed look shows from press to release.
The focus indicator appears only for keyboard focus, never after a pointer press.
Every colour change between rest, hover and pressed transitions background, border and color over durationFaster with curveEasyEase; under reduced motion the transition is 0.01ms.
disabledFocusable keeps the button in the tab order and lets it take focus and show its ring, but it ignores activation and reports aria-disabled.
Subtle and transparent buttons show the filled variant of an icon while hovered or pressed and the regular variant otherwise; a disabled button always shows the regular one.

semantics: an icon-only button needs an aria-label, since its icon has no text

notes.text: Vertical padding (3, 1, 5, 8, 7px), minimum widths (64, 96px) and icon sizes (20, 24px) are constants in the styles file; no token gives them.

The focus ring is drawn inside the button, not around it: the border itself turns colorStrokeFocus2 and a 1px ring sits inside that. An implementation drawing the generic 2px outside outline (createFocusOutlineStyle) gets the wrong look for buttons.
Rounded shape sets no radius itself; the size does. Small and large buttons still use borderRadiusMedium for the box, and only their focus ring changes radius.

Under forced colours: primary is Highlight with HighlightText text and border, inverting on hover and press; every appearance's hover and press become HighlightText background with Highlight text and border; focus turns the border ButtonText; disabled is ButtonFace with GrayText text and border.
Secondary is the default appearance: the styles file's secondary class is empty because the base class already is that look.
